spec_match.rationale: Runs the registry's exact scheme vocabulary (null, cenc, cbcs, cbcs-1-9) plus a bogus control column across three codecs through the real decodingInfo(), and cross-checks against EME requestMediaKeySystemAccess with the same encryptionScheme member the polyfill path uses.

interactive.rationale: Key-system select and two buttons drive 15 real decodingInfo() calls and 15 real requestMediaKeySystemAccess() calls, filling two live tables cell by cell with per-cell supported/smooth/powerEfficient/access detail.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a side-by-side per-scheme comparison plus an EME cross-check; both matrices exist and run.

edge_cases.rationale: The bogus column is a built-in honesty control; the verdict line distinguishes 'member dropped', 'genuinely filtering', and 'baseline key system unavailable' instead of conflating them.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/4644898109259776 and the EME encryptionScheme registry section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite mirrors the matrix's core contracts (bogus and empty-string schemes must be unsupported when null is supported) and fails them honestly pre-152.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Full autorun (both matrices, 30 real API calls) verified in headless Chromium 141 on desktop+mobile via Playwright/CDP with clean console; but no Chrome 152 was available, so the decodingInfo matrix was only observed in its honest 'member dropped' state — the EME matrix did show real per-scheme filtering.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts matrix completion, the honored/dropped verdict, and the EME cross-check separately, with unavailable fallbacks reported as failures rather than passes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; pass/fail cells are encoded with accent-emerald/rose border accents plus explicit yes/no words, keeping text on AA-compliant paper/ivory backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic tables with caption, th scope=col/row; cells carry words not just color; the verdict line is an aria-live polite output; controls are native and labelled.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports driven: the 44rem-min-width tables scroll inside their own overflow-x:auto wrappers so the page itself has 0px horizontal overflow at 360px; controls become full-width; screenshots of both classes reviewed.

openQuestions.title: Capture a genuine per-scheme decodingInfo split on Chrome 152
openQuestions.detail: On this sandbox's Chromium 141 the decodingInfo matrix correctly reports that the member was dropped (bogus column matches null), while the EME matrix shows real filtering. On Chrome 152 the decodingInfo matrix should flip: bogus becomes no while cenc stays yes. Verify and record that state.

openQuestions.title: Matrix runs 30 sequential queries — consider parallelism if slow on low-end devices
openQuestions.detail: Cells fill sequentially to keep readouts orderly; on slow devices the full run takes a few seconds. If real-visitor telemetry shows abandonment, batch the queries with Promise.all per row while keeping per-cell updates.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table matrix mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide tables must scroll inside their own overflow-x:auto container instead of widening the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both matrices sit in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with table min-width:44rem; document overflow measured 0px at 360x740 after the fix.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table semantics and live status
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use caption and th scope for data tables; never encode state in color alone; announce async completion via a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both tables have captions and scoped headers, cells say 'yes — supported'/'no'/'rejected' in words with color only as reinforcement, and the verdict line is aria-live=polite.

guidanceConsulted.query: async API result table loading states
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Show explicit in-flight state and avoid layout shift while async work completes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Cells render an ellipsis placeholder grid immediately, statuses have min-height, and each cell is replaced in place as its query resolves.

summary: Side-by-side scheme comparison over the real API: on the sandbox's Chromium 141 the decodingInfo matrix honestly reported 'bogus column matches null — member dropped (pre-152)' while the EME requestMediaKeySystemAccess cross-check showed genuine per-scheme filtering (bogus scheme denied with NotSupportedError), which is precisely the gap Chrome 152 closes.
